assets.prompt:
Editorial illustration for a regional city guide. Flat shapes with subtle paper grain, limited palette, soft daylight, calm composition with generous negative space in the upper third for overlaying a title. No people's faces in detail (if people appear they are small, distant, simplified, diverse). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signage writing, logos, watermarks, flags, religious icons or political symbols. Avoid tourist-postcard clichés and do not combine many landmarks in one frame. 16:9, high resolution.
A morning street-food stall at dawn: steam rising from stacked bamboo steamers rendered as simple shapes, plastic stools, a single bare light bulb, mountains faintly visible far behind. Warm amber light, deep green shadows. No signboards.
Palette: night green #10221F, lamp amber #F2A93B, tea green #1D6450, cream #F6EBD9, temple red #A8352A sparingly. Same coherent flat editorial paper-cut illustration series. Keep primary subject within central 60% width and height; outer 20% edges expendable for cropping.  No indigenous motifs, costumes or patterns; no deities; no maps or island outlines.
Avoid: text, letters, characters, calligraphy, signage text, logo, watermark, flag, religious statue, shrine deity, protest, stereotype costume, geisha, samurai, rising sun, casino, neon cyberpunk fog, collage of landmarks, purple gradient, 3D render, glossy
Generate one image only, 1600×900 landscape.
STRICT ART DIRECTION: very simple flat vector-like paper cut shapes, not a detailed painting, not realistic. No people at all. The steamer stack and stall counter must be compact, centred at x=50%, y=55%, entirely within x=20–80% and y=20–80%; no main subject at right edge. No sun disc. Use only five palette colours and gentle grain. Only one stall, two small simple stools, one bare bulb, three steamers. Large quiet empty upper third.
assets.palette_usage: deep green structure, tea-green layers, amber illumination, cream highlights; red sparingly
